sentences.text: % 19.05.2023 CRL.M.A. 13591/2023 Exemption 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 150/2023, under Sections 376/506 of the IPC, registered at P.S.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that post registration of the present FIR, the petitioner has married respondent no. 2.
